newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shell Singapore to shut thermal cracker Jan 13-24.
newsitem.headline: Shell Singapore to shut thermal cracker Jan 13-24.

text.p: Shell Singapore will shut a 11,000 tonne per day thermal cracker for routine maintenance from January 13-24, a company spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
"The unit will be down for 12-days for routine decoking and maintenance," she said. The unit is usually closed every six-months for such maintenance works.
The same unit was partially closed on December 7 for about 11 days following a leak in a furnace which led to a 5,000 tonne a day production loss.
The unit cracks heavy residual fuel to produce between 30 and 40 percent of middle distillate with fuel oil making up the rest.
